overview.label: Story
overview.heading: Overview
overview.body: Led design and Unity 3D development of a scalable VR home therapy program for chronic pain and stress relief — storyboarding, shaders, particles, spatial design, and sound design. Built for Harvard MedTech.

problem.label: Problem
problem.heading: Why this needed to exist
problem.body: Chronic pain and stress need non-pharmacological relief that holds attention and feels safe at home.

approach.label: Approach
approach.heading: How the work got done
approach.body: End-to-end VR universe: storyboarding, custom shaders, particle systems, spatial audio, and narrative pacing for a scalable home-therapy program.

outcomes.label: Outcomes
outcomes.heading: What changed once it shipped
outcomes.body: Delivered for Harvard MedTech — immersive storytelling that grounds users and supports pain reduction through presence.

credits.label: Credits
credits.heading: One last thing
credits.body: Designed for Harvard MedTech — Led design and Unity 3D development of a scalable VR home therapy program for chronic pain and stress relief — storyboarding, shaders, particles, spatial design, and sound design. Built for Harvard MedTech.
